description.en: Plays a short scripted vignette where the player character stops, turns to face a given position, and a speech bubble is shown, while the camera pans in — runs the character-turn, camera-pan and text child threads concurrently, then restores RPG control.
Message ID to show in the speech bubble via CreateSpeech.
Optional 3-element position [x, y, z] the player character turns to face (defaults to [0, 0, 0]).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Stop the player, have them look at a position, and show a message
StopEventRun("null", pos);
